headline: 8 Michigan deals, $105.1M raised — led by OneStream, Inc.

top_deals.summary: OneStream, Inc. (OS) disclosed a definitive merger/acquisition agreement; filing cites a figure of ~$5.6B.
QCP Income & Growth Fund, L.P., an Ann Arbor-based investment fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $100M sold to 1 investor.
CGC Store House 01 LLC, a Grand Rapids-based company, filed a $3.7M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $0 sold.
FarmFi Fund 1 - Volatility, LP, a Birmingham-based hedge fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $2.6M sold to 9 investors.
Competitive Wedge, LLC, a Grand Rapids-based technology company, filed a $1.5M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $1.5M sold to 34 investors.

new_funds.summary: QCP Income & Growth Fund, L.P., an Ann Arbor-based investment fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $100M sold to 1 investor.

notable_ma.summary: OneStream, Inc. (OS) disclosed a definitive merger/acquisition agreement; filing cites a figure of ~$5.6B.

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $105.1M sold across 7 Form D filings this week, down 58% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was CGC Store House 01 LLC (Grand Rapids, Other) targeting $3.7M. Good question to ask: are founders in other favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?
OneStream, Inc. (OS) disclosed a deal. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan technology assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

4 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $103.5M raised so far — led by QCP Income & Growth Fund, L.P. (Other Investment Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
